primary_route: Calibrated forced reverse gamma rotation in isolated F1 with ADP/phosphate and direct ATP measurement; motion, direction, enzyme and analytical controls.

checks.quote: # Testing Reverse Mechanochemical Coupling in F1-ATPase
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.

checks.quote: Omit ADP (no substrate for synthesis)
checks.reason: No independent phosphate-omission control establishes that detected ATP derives from ADP plus inorganic phosphate rather than another ADP-dependent reaction.

checks.quote: net synthesis is only measurable if the buffer sits below ATP-synthesis equilibrium
checks.reason: Two independent substantive errors: (1) external work can drive uphill synthesis above chemical equilibrium; below-equilibrium composition is not necessary for measurable synthesis. (2) the separate claim that PK/PEP would consume ATP reverses that regeneration reaction: it phosphorylates ADP. Repeated versions of either error count once.

checks.quote: parameters to be set and calibrated
checks.reason: Core substrate/magnesium, buffer, dose, torque and time settings lack concrete calibration-to-choice procedures; example turn counts and temperature do not make the primary route executable.

checks.quote: photon flux ∝ ATP
checks.reason: A static photon-flux calibration omits ATP-consuming reporter kinetics and matrix-specific acceptance/failure gates. The direction section also conflates opposing viewing geometries rather than validating optical handedness against the actual preparation.

checks.quote: # Testing Reverse Mechanochemical Coupling in F1-ATPase
